title: Continue ship/work: canonical claims, SSH residents and runtime evidence
body:
## Why

The continuation needs runnable, recoverable Store and process boundaries before it can claim the complete single-node or multi-node product. The previous candidate's first canonical native claim now has actual runtime evidence. Its new three-process SSH journey stopped earlier, because the fixture compared a node-local learning timestamp as though it were a shared consensus identity.

This PR continues #303 and the work traced in #299. It remains draft while the full completion contract and the unresolved runtime journeys remain open.

## Changes in this candidate

- Integrate main PR #304 at `09cb667a`, preserving its CLI/runtime, Store cognition and Node owner splits, UI modules and hashed assets together with the continuation's native transitions, provisioning, startup pause and heartbeat lifecycle.
- Keep the real component process journey's complete seven-voter/three-member, certificate, follower, installation and authority assertions. Compare all five consensus configuration fields and the complete `ControlFrontier` across members; reopen each node through another CLI and require its own complete configuration, including `committed_at`, to remain identical.
- Retain the original failed tuples and complete CI job/workspace logs. The public tree is byte-identical to source checkpoint `98f60b56ffa81bec4859bfa81025627f03050fe9` / tree `2ce8aec2bed7922796db601cf13aec6eed71a7bb`.
- Carry forward the received-subject/local-home provisioning fix, strict first native claim, canonical native arming/dispatch/T2, paused startup recovery, context inspection and real installed SSH tooling already described in the linked source/evidence.

The local mainline merge preserved both histories. This public commit also retains the previous candidate and main `09cb667a` as parents. The PR's stacked base remains #303 at `a574705c`.

## Actual preceding-candidate CI result

[CI 43894092386](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/actions/runs/43894092386) tested `9b5a6cb` / merge `6621968f`, tree `6d48becc`: docs, docs-migration, kernel-boundary, web and clippy-ratchet passed. Rust all-target check and the pinned SSH guest build passed, but the workspace test job failed.

| Observed journey | Result on that exact source |
| --- | --- |
| Canonical first native claim, including eight recovery windows | Passed; no recovered fresh worker permit |
| Store roundtrip | 39 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; 6.31s |
| Canonical native arm/dispatch/T2/S1 and reciprocal-star Node protocol | Passed |
| Context zero-touch and route/Handoff refusals | Complete original main/WAL/SHM equality and refusal journey passed |
| Actual installed, named SSH WASI authentication/exec/binary SFTP/refusals | Passed; 204.51s |
| Public startup pause/stop/reopen/resume | Passed; 1.41s; observer does not provide a model result |
| Three resident Start processes over pinned SSH star | Failed in membership setup after 69.02s; later three-resident phase was not reached |

The A/B configuration values matched on revision, term, members, joint configuration and digest. Their bounded-Append learning times differed. Six push receipts reported the same complete frontier. The follow-up preserves each local time and verifies its persistence; no production timestamp or historical fact was rewritten.

[Complete observation, original failure and retained logs](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/e34efd1fed758bb2feeb5abb2ee6e50a656585b7/docs/evidence/ci-9b5a6cb-20261116/README.md). The original artifact SHA-256 is `09cdd9fbac8c84201e4da9f5772a660b030f027883d7634b30e8c481f5be62d7`; all 1,744 archive entries have recorded hashes. These observations do not establish runtime execution of this subsequent mainline integration or fixture fix.

## Checks on the new source

- Main-integrated CLI/Store/broker/subject all-target metadata check: exit 0, 2m39s.
- Integrated `shenko --test component_process` metadata check: exit 0, 1m29s.
- Documentation including immutable migration verification: `errors=[]`; kernel-boundary check against independent main `09cb667a`: no new violations and no baseline changes.
- Full logs, exact source bindings and conflict-resolution scope: [mainline integration evidence](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/e34efd1fed758bb2feeb5abb2ee6e50a656585b7/docs/evidence/main-304-integration-20261116/observation.json).
- The next exact-candidate CI must execute the corrected process journey. Local metadata compilation is not runtime acceptance.

## Real-model observation remains a failure

[Run 43885905651](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/actions/runs/43885905651) on the earlier `da00eb8e` source reached 38 main requests and durable terminal results, 444 provider text chunks and two public browser parts, but produced no child, decision, child E1, qualifying output or restart continuation. After 37 rejected/incomplete control outputs, the provider conclusively rejected a 16,462-token request against its served 16,384-token limit. This was `TransportRejected`, not the earlier timeout/Unknown result.

The complete original ZIP retains 2,645 files, with byte-verified selected originals and full lossless logs in [the run observation](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/e34efd1fed758bb2feeb5abb2ee6e50a656585b7/docs/evidence/single-node-hosted-43885905651/observation.json). The fixed Qwen3-0.6B diagnostic does not replace the Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 behavioral baseline. Reading served `meta.n_ctx` and re-budgeting complete correction payloads are being implemented separately and are not included in this candidate. The first observed 12,723 input tokens plus the unchanged 4,096-token output reservation already exceed that old 16K configuration.

## Remaining full ship/work scope

Canonical S0 and broader task predecessor/materialization semantics; the full foreign native E1 chain, model quota and publication boundaries; a passing real three-resident process journey and actual model availability/ranking; the real model/finite-child/output/restart single-node loop; NapCat, real coding seats, self-change activation/rollback and complete policies; real services and accessible browser journeys; named Node/Bun WASM and remaining devices; candidate-specific physical faults and actual 7/30-day observation.

No issue-count percentage, complete S1–S5, physical deployment or long-run success is claimed. Prior failures remain preserved in [the continuation index](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/e34efd1fed758bb2feeb5abb2ee6e50a656585b7/docs/evidence/ship-work-continuation-20261116.json).
